description.value: Top of Vancouver is a fine dining revolving restaurant perched 553 feet (167m) above street level at the top of Harbour Centre Tower, offering a slow 360-degree panoramic sweep of the city skyline, coastal mountains, and ocean as you dine. The kitchen focuses on award-winning continental cuisine with an emphasis on premium seafood and meats. A touring cyclist seeking a special-occasion splurge will find this one of the most dramatically situated dining experiences in British Columbia.
